Q1. Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.
Our hands have been crucial tools for finding and eat food, and helping us navigate the world.
options: tools for finding and eat food,
and helping us navigate the world.
questions.solution: A) 'Eat' के बदले 'Eating' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Conjunction “And" का प्रयोग दो समानांतर structure को जोड़ने के लिए किया जाता है, जिसमें वही grammatical form follow होना चाहिए। इसे parallelism कहा जाता है। sentence me “Finding” gerund के रूप में प्रयोग हुआ है तो ‘Eat’ भी Gerund form में प्रयोग होगा!

questions.q:
Q4  Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P.    The earliest years of a child’s life are critical.
Q.    This is why an establishment has been created for the protection of children in these crucial years, known as ECCE.
R.    It is during the early years that children develop the cognitive, physical, social and emotional skills that they need to succeed in life.
S.    These years determine child’s survival and thriving in life, and lay the foundation for her/ his learning and holistic development.
questions.solution:
B)PSRQ
The earliest years of a child’s life are critical. These years determine child’s survival and thriving in life, and lay the foundations for her/ his learning and holistic development. It is during the early years that children develop the cognitive, physical, social and emotional skills that they need to succeed in life. This is why an establishment has been created for the protection of children in these crucial years, known as ECCE.

Q5. Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".
A witness had seen a youth, / perhaps aged young as/ ten or eleven, acting suspiciously
options: A witness had seen a youth,
questions.solution: C) Perhaps aged young as के बदले perhaps as young as क्योंकि "As + positive degree of adjective + As" सही comparative structure है, जिसका प्रयोग उन लोगों या चीजों की तुलना करने के लिए किया जाता है जो किसी तरह से समान हैं। इस case में, "As young" सही structure है, जिसका अर्थ है कि Youth दस या ग्यारह साल की उम्र (या उससे भी छोटे) हो सकता है।

Q9. Select the option that will improve the (bracketed) part of the sentence. In case of no improvement select the option 'No improvement'.
Check all radiators for (meagre leaks, special) round pipework connections.
questions.solution: A) "Small" is a better adjective than "meagre" to describe leaks. "Meagre" suggests a small amount of something and is often used in the context of inadequate or insufficient quantities. On the other hand, "small" directly refers to the size, which is more suitable for describing a leak.
